Added to the base shock chance of every lightning spell hit. A shock gives a stage of Shocked and stuns briefly (bosses are slowed instead).
effect.stormcaller.shocked.description: Takes 5%% more lightning damage per stage (up to 5 stages). Every new shock adds a stage and refreshes the duration.
effect.stormcaller.static_shield.descrip: Strikes melee attackers with lightning and reduces damage taken.
item.stormcaller.spell_book/lightning.sp:
Spell Book of Lightning Wizards, using storm magic that leaps from foe to foe
- Strengths: Hits that jump between enemies, short stuns
- Weaknesses: Low damage against a single target, very low defense
- Equipment: Lightly armored
spell.stormcaller.chain_lightning.descri: Releases a bolt of lightning that chains through up to {ricochet} additional nearby targets, causing {damage} lightning spell damage on each hit.
spell.stormcaller.chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
spell.stormcaller.lightning_bolt.descrip: Hurls a very fast bolt of lightning that jumps to {ricochet} additional nearby targets, causing {damage} lightning spell damage on each hit.
spell.stormcaller.lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
spell.stormcaller.lightning_nova.descrip: Discharges lightning around you, causing {damage} lightning spell damage and knocking targets back. Stuns for 1.5 seconds, bosses are slowed instead.
spell.stormcaller.lightning_nova.name: Lightning Nova
spell.stormcaller.lightning_strike.descr: Calls a bolt of lightning down from the sky onto the target, causing {damage} lightning spell damage within {impact_range} blocks.
spell.stormcaller.lightning_strike.name: Lightning Strike
spell.stormcaller.spark.description: Launches a spark that jumps to {ricochet} additional nearby target, causing {damage} lightning spell damage on each hit.
spell.stormcaller.spark.name: Spark
spell.stormcaller.static_shield.descript: Charges you with static electricity for {stash_duration} seconds. Melee attackers are struck back, taking {damage} lightning spell damage, and you take 10%% less damage.
spell.stormcaller.static_shield.name: Static Shield
